verdict.rationale: ADP's own docs say it will create and deliver W-2 and 1099 forms and e-file them with the IRS, and employees can view up to three years of W-2s/1099s online. The core story is delivered, though it is a paid add-on and is described only at marketing-page depth. Missing for 10: detailed docs on year-end timing and automation, independent or hands-on corroboration, and inclusion in the base package rather than an additional fee.
